answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The mirror holds work receipts rather than names, so the vault of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the orchard is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
